source: ProFood India Expo_ CMI Dashboard Topics.xlsx (75 topics; definitions, inclusions and exclusions as given)
note: player_type / market_type per market: finished food & beverage products FP-01..FP-24 are consumer brands (Brand / Marketer, B2C); FP-25 foodservice prepared foods, every Food Ingredient (FI) and food-technology equipment market (FMT) are Manufacturer, B2B; FMT-16 automation & control, FMT-18 / FMT-19 software are Solution Provider, B2B. Edit here and re-run profood/setup_briefs.py profood/markets.json --force to change a market.

markets.definition: Dairy Products includes milk, cheese, yogurt, butter, fermented dairy. The India dairy products market covers sales of commercially manufactured finished food and beverage products into retail, foodservice and institutional channels. Market sizing is based on domestic manufacturer-level product revenue, excluding equipment and ingredient supplier turnover.

markets.exclusion: Exclude: Raw milk trading; dairy machinery. Also exclude unrelated upstream/downstream market revenue.
